title: When a slice changes only a CLI or daemon message, let the UI pass skip renders, or give ork a way to print that message for a render

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The ui reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261119-145500-0d5c, project ork, item S349:

When a slice changes only a CLI or daemon message, let the UI pass skip renders, or give ork a way to print that message for a render

Evidence: S349 changes one daemon message line (internal/daemon/runs.go:1461); there is no render path for it without adding files to the tree
